newsitem.title: USA: Shopco Laurel trading halt to continue.
newsitem.headline: Shopco Laurel trading halt to continue.

text.p: Shopco Laurel Centre LP said on Thursday that the trading halt of its shares will continue as the company anticipates dissolution after it resolves the impending foreclosure of its shopping mall in Laurel, Md.

The $59.9 million mortgage loan the partnership has is set to mature October 15, 1996 and the mortgage holder intends to file a foreclosure action against the company and appoint a receiver to collect all cash flow from the mall and turn it over to the lenders, Shopco said.
Shopco said the agreement with its lender also provides for a court order that blocks the payment of a $1.35 per unit distrubtion that was scheduled to be paid on or about October 10, 1996.
The distribution will not be paid until the court order is terminated, which Shopco expects no later than March 15, 1997 and after the completion of the foreclosure, Shopco said.
After payment of the distribution and the anticipated foreclosure of the mortgage secured by the mall, Shopco said it expects to proceed toward dissolution.
The American Stock Exchange advised Shopco that it no longer meets the exchange's listing criteria and the trading halt will continue, Shopco said.
